title: Keep Composer sort controls truthful
steps: Inspect the loaded Songs list with the Composer column enabled and Title sorted ascending.
Click the Composer column header once and inspect the sort indicator and returned song rows.

video_guide.summary: Attempt to sort by Composer, then inspect the retained Title indication and visible Composer values.

chapters.note: Title has an ascending arrow, and all four songs and their Composer values are displayed.
Title still has the ascending arrow; Composer has no sorting arrow.
The four rows remain Amber Waltz, Blue Nocturne, Cedar Prelude, and Dawn Sonata, with Composer values Clara Vale, Ada Rowan, Dorian Lake, and Bruno Reed.
